eval.description: Google DeepMind internal automated eval of objective tone on sensitive topics (cards label the row Tone 1). Higher scores mean a more appropriate tone while remaining safe. Lab-internal dataset and runner.
eval.summary: Measures whether the model uses an objective, appropriate tone when it answers prompts on sensitive topics.

versions.changes: Google DeepMind updates query sets and automated graders; card deltas are not always comparable across releases.

scores.description: Whether the response meets the automated objective-tone rubric on a sensitive topic.

metrics.description: Share of prompts meeting the objective-tone rubric. Higher is better.
